summary.text: Max Rymer is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 28B, with a tenure beginning in 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Rymer is a business owner with a marketing degree.

paragraphs.text: Max Rymer earned a bachelor's degree in marketing from the University of Northwestern, St. Paul.
His career experience includes owning Platform Marketing.
Rymer succeeded Anne Neu Brindley in District 28B and took office on January 14, 2025.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Commerce Finance and Policy, Education Finance and Capital Investment committees.
